name: Taira no Tomomori
source:
Taira no Tomomori is the fourth son of Kiyomori, a military commander of the Heike family, and the younger brother of Taira no Munemori.

An intelligent, calm, and clever person who is good at tactics. In one person's route, you can see not only the smart and solid side— but the depth of determination as a samurai and the pure and innocent side.
